sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining silently returns nil when any link in the chain is absent, collapsing the entire expression to nothing
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any one person is gone, the whole path to them dissolves into nil.

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no match exists on the right, filling unmatched columns with NULL
sketches.resonance: You remain whole after the departure — every part of you still present — but where they once were, there is only NULL.
sketches.draft:
SELECT
  self.*,
  other.name
FROM   self
LEFT JOIN other
  ON self.heart = other.heart
-- returns every row of self
-- other.name: NULL

sketches.mechanism: A final variable can only be assigned once; any attempt to reassign it is a compile-time error
sketches.resonance: Some things you can only give once — the language itself forbids you from overwriting what was already settled.
